title: Partition, Refine, and Detect: Preserving Novel Category Capacity in Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.12976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) expects the model trained on base classes to recognize both base and novel classes at inference. Typical methods rely on CLIP-style vision-language embeddings, yet the learned space is often biased toward base categories, with limited effective capacity preserved for novel concepts. Such a base-dominated representation can compress novel semantics, leading to semantic collapse and mis-calibrated confidence at inference. To address this issue, we present PR-OVD, a partition-and-refine framework that explicitly reserves capacity for novel categories and strengthens category separation, while being seamlessly integrated into different detector architectures. Specifically, PR-OVD first performs coarse partitioning to build global divisions for base, novel, and an explicit background partition in both visual and textual modalities, preventing object-irrelevant embeddings from leaking into category-spec

translated_title: 分区、精炼与检测：在开放词汇目标检测中保留新类别容量
translated_abstract: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）要求在基类上训练的模型在推理时能够同时识别基类和新类别。典型方法依赖于CLIP风格的视觉-语言嵌入，然而学习到的嵌入空间往往偏向基类，为新概念保留的有效容量有限。这种由基类主导的表示可能会压缩新类别的语义，导致语义坍塌以及推理时置信度校准失准。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PR-OVD，这是一个“分区-精炼”框架，它显式地为新类别保留容量并增强类别之间的分离性，同时能够无缝集成到不同的检测器架构中。具体而言，PR-OVD首先进行粗分区，在视觉和文本两种模态中为基类、新类别以及显式背景分区构建全局划分，防止与目标无关的嵌入泄露到类别特定的……
tldr: 提出PR-OVD“分区-精炼”框架，通过显式为新类别保留嵌入容量并增强类别分离，解决了开放词汇目标检测中由基类主导表示导致的语义坍塌与置信度失准问题。
en_tdlr: PR-OVD is a partition-and-refine framework that explicitly reserves embedding capacity for novel categories and strengthens category separation, addressing semantic collapse and miscalibrated confidence caused by base-dominated representations in open-vocabulary object detection.
